_comment: APEX ledger config. Copy to <PROJECT_ROOT>/.apex/config.json and fill in. Keys are camelCase and must match ApexConfig exactly — a key APEX does not recognise is reported, never silently ignored.
_verifyCommandsNote: Tier names are exactly these. There is no 'test' or 'run' tier — the whole-project check is 'suite', and executing the thing is 'runtime'.
_contextNote: The attached-context guard's budget. context.budgetTokens is the token ceiling for the whole working context; attached content over 50% is refused, over 25% warns (54 §11.1).
_skillsNote: Model-facing skill selection (54 §8/§7). maxBodiesPerTask caps how many skill bodies load for one task; seedSkills ships the bundled seed library.
_capabilitiesNote: Host-provided code intelligence (54 §14). APEX never installs language servers; hostDiagnostics lets a host that already exposes semantic diagnostics record them as evidence. diagnosticsMessage holds the latest host-reported message (evidence only).
_delegationNote: See core/13-FLEET.md. mode: OFF | AUTO | DIRECTED_ONLY | AGGRESSIVE
